CustomField.description: Matching criteria for the Booking Form email templates: Legacey at New or Booked, Drizzle at New, or any booking whose First Applicant was changed and whose new signed Booking Form is not uploaded yet. The templates must not add their own stage condition.
CustomField.formula: OR( AND( NOT(Signed_Booking_Form_Uploaded__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Last_First_Applicant_Change_Id__c)) ), AND(Project__r.Name = "The Legacey", New_or_Booked_Stage__c), AND(Project__r.Name = "The Drizzle", ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "New")) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the Booking Form mail can be sent: The Legacey at New or Booked, The Drizzle at New, or after a First Applicant Change until the new signed Booking Form is uploaded.
CustomField.label: Booking Form Mail Allowed
